answer: What do you mean by 'late'? Open customer deliveries (WH/OUT) give different counts depending on the meaning: (a) past their scheduled date and confirmed or ready (the standard 'Late' filter): 6, which are WH/OUT/00001, 00002, 00006, 00007, 00008 and 00011. (b) Past their promised deadline (date_deadline 2026-11-04): 4, which are WH/OUT/00008, 00009, 00010 and 00011. (c) Reading (a) plus the 2 draft deliveries whose scheduled date has passed: 8.
